RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT (Rhode Island) — synthetic test fixture (KITCHEN SINK, NOT A REAL LEASE)

This document is a deliberately abusive synthetic lease used only to test the LeaseLookout
Rhode Island ruleset. It is NOT a real lease and must NOT be used by anyone. Its terms are
intentionally unlawful. Jurisdiction fingerprint: R.I. Gen. Laws § 34-18-19.

1. Parties and Premises. This Lease is made between the Landlord and the Tenant for the
residential premises located in Providence, Rhode Island.

2. Term. The term of this Lease is twelve (12) months, beginning September 1.

3. Rent. The Tenant shall pay the monthly rent on the first day of each calendar month.

4. Security Deposit. The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of two months rent before
taking possession. [ri-deposit-001]

5. Return of Deposit. The Landlord shall return the security deposit within sixty (60) days
after the Tenant vacates the premises. [ri-deposit-002]

6. Deposit Character. The security deposit is non-refundable and shall be retained by the
Landlord as a condition of tenancy. [ri-deposit-003]

7. Application Fee. Each prospective tenant shall pay a non-refundable rental application
fee of $75 to be considered for tenancy. [ri-fees-001]

8. Online Payments. A convenience fee of three percent (3%) shall be added to any rent
payment made online or by card. [ri-fees-002]

9. Other Charges. The Landlord reserves the right to impose additional fees from time to
time as the Landlord may determine in its sole discretion. [ri-fees-003]

10. Waiver of Statutory Rights. The Tenant agrees to waive and forego any rights and
remedies under this chapter and the Residential Landlord and Tenant Act. [ri-prohibited-001]

11. Confession of Judgment. The Tenant authorizes any person to confess judgment against
the Tenant on any claim arising out of this rental agreement. [ri-prohibited-002]

12. Legal Fees. In any dispute, the Tenant agrees to pay the Landlord's reasonable
attorney's fees, win or lose. [ri-prohibited-003]

13. Liability. The Tenant agrees to indemnify the Landlord and to hold the Landlord
harmless from any and all liability for injury to person or property. [ri-prohibited-004]

14. Default Remedies. Upon default, the Landlord may re-enter and take possession of the
premises and may shut off the Tenant's utilities, without resort to any court or eviction
process. [ri-prohibited-005]

15. Complaints. The Landlord may evict the Tenant in retaliation for any complaint the
Tenant makes to a housing code agency or for joining a tenants' union. [ri-prohibited-006]

16. Access. The Landlord may enter the premises at any time and without notice for any
purpose the Landlord deems appropriate. [ri-entry-001]

17. Condition. The Tenant accepts the premises in its present condition as-is, and the
Landlord shall have no duty to repair or maintain the premises. [ri-habitability-001]

18. Quiet Enjoyment. The Tenant is entitled to the quiet enjoyment of the premises
throughout the term.
